dossier.purpose: Dependabot-Core is the Ruby monorepo behind GitHub's Dependabot version and security updates (README.md:32). Given a repository's dependency files it fetches and parses them, finds the latest resolvable (or minimum security-fix) version, rewrites manifests/lockfiles, builds PR text and opens/updates PRs on GitHub, GHE, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket or CodeCommit (README.md:48; common/lib/dependabot/pull_request_creator.rb:275-281). It ships 33 ecosystem gems (rakelib/support/helpers.rb:21-58) including github_actions (rewrites `uses:` refs in workflows and action.yml, including commit-SHA pins and trailing '# vX.Y.Z' comments: github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/update_checker.rb:285-289, .../file_updater/workflow_updater/version_commenter.rb:24-35) and docker. It is a library, not a standalone product: the in-repo `updater/` runner is documented as an internal component whose API is only reachable inside GitHub's network (updater/README.md:3-10) and the README sends self-hosters to the separate Dependabot CLI repo (README.md:55-62). The repo also runs Dependabot on itself, including a `github-actions` ecosystem entry (.github/dependabot.yml:89-97).

claims.claim: Dependabot-Core is the library at the heart of Dependabot security / version updates.

Generates automated PRs updating dependencies for Ruby, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Dart, Elixir, Elm, Go, Rust, Java, Julia and .NET; can also update git submodules, Docker files, Opentofu, Terraform files and Pre-Commit hooks (GitHub Actions is not named in the README).
Features: latest version that is resolvable given the project's other dependencies; updated manifest and lockfiles; PR descriptions with changelogs, release notes and commits.
On GitHub.com / GHE the hosted service is enabled by checking a dependabot.yml into the repo's .github directory.
Supports opening PRs against GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, GitLab, BitBucket and AWS CodeCommit.
Dependabot-Core is a library, so an entrypoint script of some kind is needed.
The open-source Dependabot CLI is the recommended standalone entrypoint, used in production at GitHub; it creates dependency diffs but does not create PRs.

A custom Ruby wrapper must itself provide an isolated throw-away environment, guard against arbitrary code execution exfiltrating credentials, supply language runtimes and handle changes Dependabot makes to its runtime environment.
The DEPENDABOT environment variable can be checked to detect the Dependabot container.
Pre-built images are only available for AMD64; on ARM they run 2x-3x slower than manually built ARM images.

Passing private-registry credentials to native package managers is a risk for ecosystems that run untrusted manifests; GitHub's service wraps Dependabot-Core in a credentials proxy so it never sees private-registry credentials.
Security vulnerabilities in Dependabot are reported per the project's security policy via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.
Tests run automatically on PRs and style is enforced by RuboCop.
Release: run the 'Gems - Bump Version' workflow, merge the PR, tag vX.Y.Z, then another GitHub Action workflow pushes the release to RubyGems.

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes: pre-built updater images are AMD64 (README.md:142) and are published from ubuntu-latest runners (.github/workflows/images-latest.yml:56); dev and test flow is Docker-only (.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md:13-14)
platforms.wsl2: unknown: no WSL/WSL2 mention in README, *.md, bin/, script/, .devcontainer or .vscode (searched); a Docker-based flow is documented but WSL2 is not
platforms.macos_arm64: yes, with caveats: Docker-based use on Docker Desktop is documented (README.md:123); pre-built images are AMD64-only and run 2x-3x slower on ARM, so ARM images should be built locally (README.md:142, 156-157); bin/docker-dev-shell has a Darwin branch for Docker/Rancher Desktop (bin/docker-dev-shell:112-116); CI builds only the bundler image on an ARM runner (.github/workflows/ci-arm64.yml:15-26)
platforms.gpu: no: not applicable; no GPU/CUDA/NVIDIA references in README, *.md, bin/, script/, Dockerfiles, docker-bake.hcl or .github (searched)

integrations.cli: No standalone CLI binary in this repo. README recommends the separate Dependabot CLI (https://github.com/dependabot/cli; README.md:55-62; not opened). CI installs it with `go install github.com/dependabot/cli/cmd/dependabot@latest` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:178, smoke.yml:88) and drives updater images with `dependabot test/update ... --updater-image` (smoke.yml:132-138; silent/README.md:17-21). In-repo scripts: bin/dry-run.rb (dev container only, bin/dry-run.rb:53-60), bin/docker-dev-shell, bin/test, script/build, script/dependabot (wrapper around the CLI with source mounts, script/dependabot:5-43).
integrations.mcp: none found (searched README, *.md, .github, scripts and config files for MCP / Model Context Protocol)
integrations.sdk_or_api: Ruby library only: gems published to RubyGems with a `dependabot-omnibus` meta-gem (README.md:483-487, 542-549; omnibus/dependabot-omnibus.gemspec:29-62); integrators write their own Ruby wrapper (README.md:64-66). No HTTP API server in this repo: `updater/` is a client of an internal Dependabot service API not open to integrators (updater/lib/dependabot/api_client.rb:10-17), with a container contract of env vars (updater/lib/dependabot/environment.rb:12-44) and commands `update_files` / `update_graph` (updater/bin/run:4-16).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: none found. Only GitHub Copilot agent assets: .github/copilot-instructions.md:1, .github/instructions/*.instructions.md, .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml:1-17. No CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/, .codex/ or .mcp.json.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No product-analytics/phone-home code found in the gems. Network use is functional: (1) git-host APIs and git clones for fetching files and opening PRs (common/lib/dependabot/pull_request_creator.rb:275-281; github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/update_checker.rb:229-256 clones action repos); (2) package registries per ecosystem; (3) PR bodies route github.com links through redirect.github.com unless disabled (pull_request_creator.rb:21-31). The `updater/` runner additionally requires a Dependabot service API: DEPENDABOT_API_URL (default http://localhost:3001), DEPENDABOT_JOB_ID, DEPENDABOT_JOB_TOKEN, DEPENDABOT_JOB_PATH, DEPENDABOT_OUTPUT_PATH (updater/lib/dependabot/environment.rb:12-44); it posts PR payloads, errors, metrics (increment_metric), ecosystem/cooldown metadata and dependency-submission snapshots there (updater/lib/dependabot/api_client.rb:39-61, 247-366); the API is described as available only inside GitHub's hosted infrastructure, with the CLI's local API as a stand-in (api_client.rb:10-17, 344-345; updater/README.md:9-10). Error tracking: the Sentry SDK is initialised on updater start (updater/lib/dependabot/setup.rb:20-67) with a before_send sanitiser that redacts auth tokens and repo names (updater/lib/dependabot/sentry/exception_sanitizer_processor.rb:13-41); no DSN is set in repo code (searched), so whether events leave the container depends on SDK env configuration not verifiable here. OpenTelemetry export is opt-in via OTEL_ENABLED=true (updater/lib/dependabot/opentelemetry.rb:29-31, 39-61). Accounts/tokens: a token for the target git provider is needed to open PRs; bin/dry-run.rb treats LOCAL_GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN as optional (bin/dry-run.rb:179-186; README.md:277) although its header says it is needed (bin/dry-run.rb:15-16); tests use DEPENDABOT_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN (updater/README.md:36-37). Hosted runs are tokenless behind a MITM credentials proxy that is not in this repo (github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/lockfile/env.rb:12-34; deno/Dockerfile:10-16; README.md:508-520). Image builds fetch from Ubuntu mirrors, packagecloud, PPAs and GitHub releases (Dockerfile.updater-core:14-75, 159-160); CI smoke tests read scenarios from the dependabot/smoke-tests repo via the GitHub API (.github/workflows/smoke.yml:52, 100).

entry_points.what: Fetches dependency files then runs UpdateFilesCommand (updater/bin/update_files.rb:39-49)
Fetches files then runs UpdateGraphCommand, producing a GitHub Dependency Submission snapshot (updater/bin/update_graph.rb:39-49)
Simulates a full update run and prints the diff without creating a PR; refuses to run outside the dev container unless ALLOW_DRY_RUN_STANDALONE=true (bin/dry-run.rb:5-13, 53-60)
Docker developer shell used for dry-runs and tests (README.md:147); bin/test runs suites in the dev image (bin/test:6-18)
Builds the updater-core and ecosystem images via docker_build in script/_common (script/build:1-13; script/_common:96-199)
Rake tasks `gems:build` and `gems:release` (build, tag check, sigstore sign, gem push) (rakelib/gems.rake:7-63)
Wrapper that runs the external `dependabot` CLI with local source directories mounted into the updater image (script/dependabot:5-43)

code.architecture: Monorepo of Ruby gems (Sorbet-typed). common/lib/dependabot/ holds shared base classes and registries (file_fetchers.rb, file_parsers.rb, update_checkers.rb, file_updaters.rb, metadata_finders.rb, dependency_graphers.rb), git helpers (git_commit_checker.rb, git_metadata_fetcher.rb, git_cooldown_date_resolver.rb), PR creators/updaters for five providers (pull_request_creator/{github,gitlab,azure,bitbucket,codecommit}.rb, pull_request_updater/*), shared_helpers.rb (spawns native helpers) and provider clients. Each of 33 ecosystem gems (<eco>/lib/dependabot/<eco>/) implements FileFetcher, FileParser, UpdateChecker, FileUpdater, MetadataFinder, Version, Requirement (README.md:469-477); many delegate to native helpers in the host language under <eco>/helpers (bundler v2/v4 Ruby, npm_and_yarn TypeScript, bun JS, go_modules Go, python/uv Python, composer PHP, hex Elixir, pub Dart, julia Julia, nuget C#/.NET in nuget/helpers/lib/NuGetUpdater). updater/lib/dependabot/ is the job runner GitHub uses (updater.rb, updater/operations/*, job.rb, file_fetcher_command.rb, update_files_command.rb, update_graph_command.rb, api_client.rb, service.rb, setup.rb) plus updater/lib/github_api/dependency_submission.rb; it reads a job definition and talks to a Dependabot service API (api_client.rb:10-17). omnibus/ is the meta-gem; silent/ is a no-network test ecosystem (silent/README.md:3-11). Containers: Dockerfile.updater-core (Ubuntu 24.04, Ruby 4.0.5, git/git-lfs/mercurial/bzr, git-shim) is the base of 33 per-ecosystem images (<eco>/Dockerfile; docker-bake.hcl:17-53). GitHub Actions support: github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/{file_fetcher,file_parser,update_checker,file_updater}.rb, with workflow_file/uses_collector.rb collecting `uses:` under jobs/runs, tag-to-SHA handling behind option github_actions_pin_to_sha (update_checker.rb:285-313), version-comment rewriting (file_updater/workflow_updater/version_commenter.rb:24-56), cooldown filtering (update_checker/latest_version_finder.rb:195-249, settings in updater/lib/dependabot/job/cooldown_definition.rb:14-17), and an optional `.github/workflows/actions.lock` path that shells out to the gh-actions-lock binary (lockfile/cli_engine.rb:35-66), gated by experiment github_actions_lockfile and github.com only (file_fetcher.rb:83-84); the binary is installed with sha256 verification (github_actions/Dockerfile:5-17). Dependency-graph output: the update_graph command submits GitHub Dependency Submission snapshots (updater/lib/github_api/dependency_submission.rb:8-19, 118-146), not CycloneDX/SPDX. Security updates target the lowest non-vulnerable version (github_actions/.../update_checker.rb:273-275).
code.packaging_and_release: ARTIFACTS: (a) 36 gems from */dependabot-*.gemspec (common, omnibus, silent and 33 ecosystems; rakelib/support/helpers.rb:21-58) plus a manually published placeholder gem dependabot-core (dependabot-core.gemspec:3-5), version 0.398.0 (common/lib/dependabot.rb:5); (b) GHCR images ghcr.io/dependabot/dependabot-updater-<ecosystem> for 33 ecosystems (docker-bake.hcl:17-53) tagged with commit SHA, `latest` and `v2.0.<timestamp>` on pushes to main (.github/workflows/images-latest.yml:4-9, 19-25, 121-124); dependabot-updater-core tagged `latest` and `<version>` on v* tags (docker-bake.hcl:89-92; images-updater-core.yml:4-9, 39-43); PR-branch images tagged with the commit SHA after PR approval (images-branch.yml:90, 102, 167-177). No `platforms` in docker-bake.hcl, so images are built for the runner's native platform (README.md:142). RELEASE FLOW: a weekly cron or workflow_dispatch 'Gems - Bump Version' opens a bump PR with a GitHub App token (gems-bump-version.yml:3-6, 24-29, 78-84); a maintainer merges and creates the GitHub release/tag vX.Y.Z by hand (gems-bump-version.yml:90-98; README.md:546-549); `release: published` triggers 'Gems - Release to RubyGems' (gems-release-to-rubygems.yml:2-7) with `id-token: write`, rubygems/configure-rubygems-credentials and `gem exec rake gems:release` (lines 15-17, 37, 41), which checks HEAD == tag (rakelib/support/helpers.rb:67-81), skips versions already on rubygems.org and, when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, signs each gem with sigstore-cli 0.2.2 and pushes with `--attestation` (rakelib/gems.rake:34-47). Gemspecs set no rubygems_mfa_required, cert_chain or signing_key (searched) and RuboCop's Gemspec/RequireMFA is disabled (.rubocop.yml:25-26). No release assets, checksum files or signatures are attached to GitHub releases by any workflow. ATTESTATIONS/SBOM: images are attested with actions/attest-build-provenance with push-to-registry (images-latest.yml:126-132 also create-storage-record; images-branch.yml:179-185; images-updater-core.yml:53-58) from jobs holding id-token/attestations/artifact-metadata/packages: write; BuildKit-native provenance is disabled (`provenance: false`: images-latest.yml:96,119; images-branch.yml:151,174; images-updater-core.yml:51); no SBOM is generated or attached (no sbom option in docker-bake.hcl or workflows; no syft/trivy/cyclonedx/spdx tooling found). images-latest.yml also pulls each pushed tag through a backup registry (BACKUP_REGISTRY, lines 3, 134-138). Lockfile integrity: root Gemfile.lock and updater/Gemfile.lock carry CHECKSUMS sections (Gemfile.lock:530; updater/Gemfile.lock:661) and image builds run bundler with frozen=true (Dockerfile.updater-core:190-197).
code.tests_and_ci: TESTS: RSpec, about 772 *_spec.rb files repo-wide (per-ecosystem spec/ dirs, common/spec, updater/spec, bin/spec, bundler/helpers/v2|v4/spec), run inside Docker via <eco>/script/ci-test, mostly `bundle exec turbo_tests2 --verbose` (e.g. github_actions/script/ci-test:6), with VCR/WebMock fixtures (common/dependabot-common.gemspec:62-63). Native-helper suites: jest/ts-jest for npm_and_yarn (6 .test.ts) and bun (6 .test.js) (npm_and_yarn/helpers/package.json:13; npm_and_yarn/script/ci-test:10-13), pytest for python helpers (5 files; python/script/ci-test:7), `go test` for go_modules (go_modules/script/ci-test:5-7), xunit.v3 C# tests (102 .cs files under nuget/helpers/lib/NuGetUpdater/*.Test; NuGetUpdater.Core.Test.csproj:16) plus PowerShell tests (nuget/script/ci-test:8-12), Julia runtests.jl (2 files). Updater e2e: 60 txtar scenarios in silent/tests/testdata run by `go test` with the Dependabot CLI (silent/README.md:13-21, 84-88; script/updater-e2e). Tests are Docker-only except NuGet C# (.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md:13-24). CI (19 workflows in .github/workflows): all `uses:` refs are pinned to 40-char SHAs with version comments (regex scan found no unpinned or local refs); runners are mostly floating `ubuntu-latest`. ci.yml 'Specs' (pull_request + daily cron, not push; 36-suite matrix built with script/build and ./script/ci-test, plus updater, lint [./bin/lint = shellcheck on repo scripts + RuboCop, then `yamllint .`], rakefile tests, and a CLI integration job using `go install ...@latest`: ci.yml:3-5, 21-57, 109-125, 177-183); ci-arm64.yml (bundler image on ubuntu-24.04-arm); smoke.yml (CLI-driven per-ecosystem smoke tests from dependabot/smoke-tests); sorbet.yml + check-sorbet-typing-mode.yml (tapioca verify, srb tc, spoom coverage, typed: strict ratchet); codespell.yml; dependency-review.yml; codeql-analysis.yml; zizmor.yml; scorecards.yaml; images-latest/images-updater-core/images-branch.yml (build, `bundle check` and layer-count<126 validation, push to GHCR, attest; branch images require an APPROVED review and re-check the checked-out SHA, fork PRs are skipped: images-branch.yml:26, 52-55, 124-127); gems-bump-version.yml and gems-release-to-rubygems.yml; labeler.yml (pull_request_target, labeler.yml:4), issue-labeler.yml, stalebot.yml, copilot-setup-steps.yml. PERMISSIONS: 12 workflows set top-level `permissions: {}` and grant per job; 7 set workflow-level permissions (contents: read in ci-arm64, codespell, dependency-review, sorbet; issues: write + contents: read in issue-labeler; issues/pull-requests: write in stalebot; read-all with job-level security-events and id-token write in scorecards); no `contents: write` and no workflow_run anywhere; secrets used are GITHUB_TOKEN and a GitHub App id/private key for the bump PR (gems-bump-version.yml:28-29). FACTS KEYED TO THE SUPPLY-CHAIN QUESTIONS: (1) workflow permission/pinning auditor: zizmor (zizmorcore/zizmor-action pinned to SHA, v0.6.4, zizmor.yml:24) on push to main and all PRs; OpenSSF Scorecard (ossf/scorecard-action, scorecards.yaml:28) also runs on main + weekly but is a repo-posture scorer. (2) attestation mechanism for hosted outputs: actions/attest-build-provenance for images (see packaging), sigstore-cli for gems (rakelib/gems.rake:42-43). (3) SBOM generator (CycloneDX/SPDX) for images or directories: none found. (4) pinned-dependency freshness through PRs: Dependabot itself, configured in .github/dependabot.yml (github-actions group 'all-actions' at lines 89-97; docker 66-88; bundler 10-40; npm, pip, gomod, nuget, maven and others), implemented by this repo's github_actions ecosystem. (5) static-analysis findings as code-scanning alerts: GitHub code scanning via SARIF/security-events: CodeQL analyze (codeql-analysis.yml:86-87; languages go, javascript, python, ruby at line 43; on PRs to main and a weekly cron, not on push: lines 14-23), Scorecard SARIF via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif (scorecards.yaml:34-36), and a zizmor job with security-events: write (zizmor.yml:15-16; the action's own upload behaviour is not visible in this repo). (6) workflow linter for syntax/expressions/action inputs/run scripts: none found (no actionlint anywhere in the repo); only yamllint (ci.yml:125; .yamllint.yaml) and shellcheck over repo scripts (bin/lint:5-21).

code.security_policy: none: no SECURITY.md found at the repo root, .github/ or docs/ (searched). README.md:99 links a GitHub-hosted policy (https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/security/policy, disclosure via the GitHub Bug Bounty program) that was not opened because it is not a listed page. claim_checks.claim: Supports Ruby, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Dart, Elixir, Elm, Go, Rust, Java, Julia, .NET plus git submodules, Docker, Opentofu, Terraform and Pre-Commit (README.md:34-35)
claim_checks.evidence: Gems exist for all of them (rakelib/support/helpers.rb:21-58; docker-bake.hcl:17-53). Code also ships ecosystems the README does not list, notably github_actions (github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/*.rb; ci.yml:37) plus bazel, bun, conda, deno, devcontainers, helm, nix, sbt, swift, uv, vcpkg, so the README list understates what the code does.

claim_checks.claim: Opens PRs against GitHub, GHE, Azure DevOps, GitLab, BitBucket and AWS CodeCommit (README.md:48)
claim_checks.evidence: PullRequestCreator#create dispatches on source.provider for github, gitlab, azure, bitbucket and codecommit (common/lib/dependabot/pull_request_creator.rb:275-281), with a creator class per provider under common/lib/dependabot/pull_request_creator/. GPG commit signing exists for GitHub (pull_request_creator/github.rb:313, 560) but needs the gpgme gem, which is only a dev dependency (commit_signer.rb:55-60; dependabot-common.gemspec:51).

claim_checks.claim: This repo provides the logic for hosting your own standalone Dependabot; the library needs an entrypoint (README.md:47-51)
claim_checks.evidence: The in-repo runner updater/ is documented as an internal component whose API is only reachable inside GitHub's network, with no appetite for making it generic (updater/README.md:3-10; updater/lib/dependabot/api_client.rb:10-17). Standalone use relies on the separate Dependabot CLI standing in for that API (api_client.rb:344-345 treats job_id 'cli'; smoke.yml:132-138; silent/README.md:17-21), which is not in this repo.

claim_checks.claim: The Dependabot CLI creates dependency diffs but does not create PRs (README.md:61)
claim_checks.evidence: CLI source is in another repository. In this repo the updater posts create_pull_request payloads to an API (updater/lib/dependabot/api_client.rb:39-61) and CI drives updater images through the CLI (.github/workflows/smoke.yml:132-138), but the CLI's own behaviour cannot be checked here.

claim_checks.claim: Pre-built images are only available for AMD64; on ARM they run 2x-3x slower (README.md:142)
claim_checks.evidence: AMD64-only is consistent with the code: docker-bake.hcl:1-124 has no platforms attribute and image jobs run on ubuntu-latest (images-latest.yml:56); only the bundler image is built on an ARM runner and not published (ci-arm64.yml:15-26). The 2x-3x figure has no method or data in the repo.

claim_checks.claim: Release is tagged by hand and another workflow automatically pushes it to RubyGems (README.md:542-549)
claim_checks.evidence: gems-release-to-rubygems.yml:2-7 triggers on release published and runs `gem exec rake gems:release` (line 41) with id-token: write (line 17). Code adds a HEAD==tag guard (rakelib/support/helpers.rb:67-81) and, on GitHub Actions, sigstore signing and `gem push --attestation` (rakelib/gems.rake:41-43), which the README does not mention.

claim_checks.claim: GitHub's service wraps Dependabot-Core in a credentials proxy so private-registry credentials are never exposed to it (README.md:503-520)
claim_checks.evidence: The proxy is not in this repo. Code only shows proxy-aware behaviour: tokenless hosted mode behind a MITM proxy (github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/lockfile/env.rb:12-34) and images expecting a proxy CA (deno/Dockerfile:10-16). A related guard refuses external code execution for private registries unless `insecure-external-code-execution: allow` is set (updater/lib/dependabot/update_graph_processor.rb:23-29, 135-137).

The ci.yml lint job runs ./bin/lint (ci.yml:109-123), which runs shellcheck on repo scripts and then bin/rubocop (bin/lint:5-23), followed by `yamllint .` (ci.yml:125). Sorbet typing checks also run in CI (sorbet.yml:25-29; check-sorbet-typing-mode.yml) but are not mentioned in the README.

claim_checks.claim: dependabot-omnibus is a meta gem that simply depends on all the others (README.md:483-487)
claim_checks.evidence: omnibus/dependabot-omnibus.gemspec:29-62 lists 34 gems (common plus 33 ecosystems) but omits the test-only dependabot-silent, which exists in the gem list (rakelib/support/helpers.rb:53). The root Gemfile also omits dependabot-nix while updater/Gemfile includes it (Gemfile:5-38 vs updater/Gemfile:26).

claim_checks.claim: Security updates upgrade to the minimum non-vulnerable version rather than the latest (README.md:386-389)
claim_checks.evidence: Checked for the github_actions ecosystem: updated_ref prefers finder.lowest_security_fix_release when the dependency is vulnerable (github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/update_checker.rb:273-275) and lowest_resolvable_security_fix_version is implemented (lines 46-58). Other ecosystems were not individually checked.

benchmarks.what: Pre-built AMD64 updater images run on ARM hosts vs manually built ARM-specific images
benchmarks.source: README.md:142 (project statement; no method or data in the repo)

risks: Standalone use depends on pieces outside this repo: the in-repo `updater/` runner is an internal component that talks to a service API 'only accessible inside the GitHub network' and takes no contributions to make it generic (updater/README.md:3-10; updater/lib/dependabot/api_client.rb:10-17); README steers self-hosters to the separate Dependabot CLI and example-cli-usage repos (README.md:57-62) and the hosted credentials proxy is also absent (README.md:508-520). The library is pre-1.0 (0.398.0, common/lib/dependabot.rb:5) and README says integrators must supply isolation themselves (README.md:66).

Image build inputs are mostly floating: base and tool images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned (ubuntu:24.04 Dockerfile.updater-core:2; ruby:4.0.5-bookworm line 149; golang/rust/python/uv/maven/nix/cosign/regctl tags in */Dockerfile; only helm/Dockerfile:9-15 and gradle/Dockerfile:8 use @sha256); ecosystem images start FROM ghcr.io/dependabot/dependabot-updater-core with no tag (e.g. bundler/Dockerfile:2); `apt-get upgrade -y` and PPAs run at build (Dockerfile.updater-core:61-69). Several downloads are unverified: git-shim via `curl -sL` with no checksum (Dockerfile.updater-core:159-160) and curl|sh or 'latest' installers for deno, julia, composer and Miniconda (deno/Dockerfile:8, julia/Dockerfile:15, composer/Dockerfile:43, conda/Dockerfile:10). Other images do verify (github_actions/Dockerfile:12-16 sha256; terraform/Dockerfile:14-18; docker/Dockerfile:17-21 cosign).

Workflow hygiene gaps despite SHA-pinned actions: the Dependabot CLI is installed with `go install ...@latest` (ci.yml:177-178; smoke.yml:87-88); no actionlint or other workflow-expression linter exists (yamllint + shellcheck only: ci.yml:123-125, bin/lint:5-23); some run: steps interpolate expressions straight into shell (check-sorbet-typing-mode.yml:32 loops over ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}; images-branch.yml:41,45,122; gems-bump-version.yml:50,66,70); runners are floating ubuntu-latest. The github_actions ecosystem only tracks `uses:` keys under jobs/runs and skips `./` and `docker://` refs (workflow_file/uses_collector.rb:36-47; file_parser.rb:80), so tools fetched inside run: steps are outside its scope.

No SBOM and no BuildKit provenance: no CycloneDX/SPDX tooling (searched), `provenance: false` on every bake build (images-latest.yml:96,119; images-branch.yml:151,174; images-updater-core.yml:51), only GitHub build-provenance attestations for images and sigstore attestations for gems, and no checksums or signatures attached to GitHub releases. Dependabot's own inventory output is a GitHub Dependency Submission snapshot (updater/lib/github_api/dependency_submission.rb:8-19, 118-146) with ecosystem-specific graphers only for bun, npm_and_yarn, go_modules, uv and pip; other ecosystems use a best-effort Generic grapher that takes the right-most file as the lockfile (common/lib/dependabot/dependency_graphers.rb:20-26; dependency_graphers/generic.rb:14-22).

Telemetry/third-party reporting code is present in the runner: the Sentry SDK is initialised at startup (updater/lib/dependabot/setup.rb:20-67) with no DSN in code (delivery depends on SDK env config, not verifiable here); OpenTelemetry is opt-in via OTEL_ENABLED with HTTP auto-instrumentation (updater/lib/dependabot/opentelemetry.rb:29-61); metrics and metadata are posted to the service API (api_client.rb:287-366). Operators running the updater outside GitHub must supply or redirect DEPENDABOT_API_URL (default http://localhost:3001, environment.rb:32-34).

Platform and reproducibility: tests and dev flow are Docker-only (.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md:13-14); pre-built images are AMD64-only and slow on ARM (README.md:142); CI covers ARM only for the bundler image build (ci-arm64.yml:15-26); WSL2 is undocumented; builds pull many toolchains at image-build time (Dockerfile.updater-core:14-109; nuget/Dockerfile:21-57). Update order is shuffled unless UPDATER_DETERMINISTIC=true (updater/lib/dependabot/updater/operations/update_all_versions.rb:90-93; environment.rb:62-66), which affects the reproducibility of PR sets.

Security-governance gaps visible in-repo: no SECURITY.md (README.md:99 links an external policy); RuboCop Gemspec/RequireMFA is disabled and gemspecs set no rubygems_mfa_required (.rubocop.yml:25-26); the CodeQL matrix covers go, javascript, python and ruby only, so the C# NuGetUpdater and PHP/Elixir/Dart helpers are not scanned, and it runs on PRs and a weekly cron rather than on push (codeql-analysis.yml:14-23, 43); releases depend on a maintainer manually tagging (README.md:546-549).

Scope, maintenance and licensing: 33 ecosystems with native helpers in about ten languages are owned by a single CODEOWNERS group (CODEOWNERS:1-4); MAINTENANCE_STANDARDS.md:3-4 reserves the right to 'cease guaranteeing support' for old package-manager versions; stalebot closes issues/PRs after 730 days plus 7 (stalebot.yml:25-28). License is MIT (LICENSE:1-3) but there is no NOTICE or third-party license inventory for the many toolchains baked into the images (searched).

checks.statement: Docker: pre-built ecosystem updater image (README example is Go modules): `docker pull ghcr.io/dependabot/dependabot-updater-gomod`
checks.note: README.md:139 (Quickstart) contains this exact command. It matches what is published: docker-bake.hcl:14 sets prefix ghcr.io/dependabot/dependabot-updater-, docker-bake.hcl:33 maps go_modules to image 'gomod', and images-latest.yml:74,123 push UPDATER_IMAGE:latest on pushes to main, so the untagged pull resolves to :latest.

LICENSE:1-21 is the standard MIT text ('MIT License', 'Copyright GitHub, Inc.'). common/dependabot-common.gemspec:15 sets spec.license = "MIT" and the ecosystem/omnibus gemspecs use common_gemspec.license. The only non-MIT license string ('Nonstandard', License Zero) is in a bundler spec fixture (bundler/spec/fixtures/projects/bundler2/local_gemspec_needs_updates/...), not project metadata.

checks.statement: yes: pre-built updater images are AMD64 (README.md:142) and are published from ubuntu-latest runners (.github/workflows/images-latest.yml:56); dev and test flow is Docker-only (.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md:13-14)
checks.note: README.md:142: 'Pre-built images are currently only available for AMD64 / Intel architecture.' images-latest.yml:56 is 'runs-on: ubuntu-latest' on the push-updater-image (Deploy) job. testing.instructions.md:13-14: 'All tests must run inside Docker containers ... will not work on the host system.' The NuGet C# exception (lines 16-24) is outside the cited lines and is noted elsewhere in the dossier.

checks.statement: No standalone CLI binary in this repo; README recommends the separate Dependabot CLI; CI installs it with `go install github.com/dependabot/cli/cmd/dependabot@latest` and drives updater images with `dependabot test/update ... --updater-image`; in-repo scripts bin/dry-run.rb (dev container only), bin/docker-dev-shell, bin/test, script/build, script/dependabot (CLI wrapper with source mounts)
checks.note: README.md:57 calls the CLI 'our recommended entrypoint for standalone use cases' (line 61: diffs, no PRs). ci.yml:178 and smoke.yml:88 both run the go install @latest command. smoke.yml:132-138 runs 'dependabot test ... --updater-image=...:latest'. silent/README.md:20 shows 'dependabot update ... --updater-image'. bin/dry-run.rb:53-60 exits unless the user is 'dependabot' or ALLOW_DRY_RUN_STANDALONE=true. script/dependabot:5-43 calls 'dependabot' with -v source mounts. bin/docker-dev-shell, bin/test and script/build exist. There is no CLI source in the repo (the only cmd/*.go files are go_modules spec fixtures).

checks.statement: Supports Ruby, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Dart, Elixir, Elm, Go, Rust, Java, Julia, .NET plus git submodules, Docker, Opentofu, Terraform and Pre-Commit (README.md:34-35): verified yes; code also ships github_actions, bazel, bun, conda, deno, devcontainers, helm, nix, sbt, swift, uv, vcpkg, which the README does not list
checks.note: README.md:34-35 matches. All 36 gemspecs listed in helpers.rb:21-58 exist on disk. Each README item maps to a gem and a published image (docker-bake.hcl:17-53): bundler, npm_and_yarn, python, composer, pub, hex, elm, go_modules, cargo, maven/gradle, julia, nuget/dotnet_sdk, git_submodules, docker/docker_compose, opentofu, terraform, pre_commit. github_actions has gem code (github_actions/lib/dependabot/github_actions/*.rb) and a CI suite (ci.yml:37). A README search finds none of the extra ecosystem names; the one 'devcontainers' hit (line 401) is a VS Code URL. Nuance: bun/deno and uv/conda belong to JavaScript and Python, which the README names as languages.
